Load in the New York City Yellow Taxi trip data into a data frame.
```{r}
setwd('../data')

library(arrow)

trip_data <- read_parquet('taxi_data.parquet')
```

Remove the rows from the dataframe that will not be used as predictors.
```{r}
trip_data <- read_parquet('taxi_data.parquet')
trip_data_relevant <- subset(trip_data, select = -c(VendorID, store_and_fwd_flag, fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tolls_amount, improvement_surcharge,
                                           congestion_surcharge, Airport_fee, cbd_congestion_fee, request_source))

# Remove any rows that contain NaN values.
trip_data_no_nans <- na.omit(trip_data_relevant)

# Only include trips in which the customer payed by card (since tip amounts were only tracked for this payment method). Furthermore, remove any datapoints for which a negative tip value was recorded. These data are evidently unreliable.
trip_data_card <- trip_data_no_nans[trip_data_no_nans$payment_type == 1 & trip_data_no_nans$tip_amount >= 0, ]

# Remove the payment_type column, since it now only includes trips with credit card payments (i.e. it is a column of 1's)
trip_data_new <- subset(trip_data_card, select = -c(payment_type))

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

# Create a new column that specifies time of day.
trip_data_time = mutate(trip_data_new,
       time_of_day = case_when(
         6 <= as.integer(format(trip_data_new$tpep_pickup_datetime,"%H")) & as.integer(format(trip_data_new$tpep_pickup_datetime,"%H")) <= 11 ~ "morning",
         12 <= as.integer(format(trip_data_new$tpep_pickup_datetime,"%H")) & as.integer(format(trip_data_new$tpep_pickup_datetime,"%H")) <= 17 ~ "afternoon",
         18 <= as.integer(format(trip_data_new$tpep_pickup_datetime,"%H")) & as.integer(format(trip_data_new$tpep_pickup_datetime,"%H")) <= 23 ~ "evening",
         0 <= as.integer(format(trip_data_new$tpep_pickup_datetime,"%H")) & as.integer(format(trip_data_new$tpep_pickup_datetime,"%H")) <= 5 ~ "night"
       )
       )

# Create a new column that specifies whether the ride took place on a holiday or not. (Dataset is from July, so the only holiday is Independence Day).
trip_data_holiday = mutate(trip_data_time,
       is_holiday = case_when(
         as.integer(format(trip_data_time$tpep_pickup_datetime, "%d")) == 4 ~ 1,
         as.integer(format(trip_data_time$tpep_pickup_datetime, "%d")) != 4 ~ 0
       )
       )

# Create a new column that gives the total trip time.
trip_data_duration = mutate(trip_data_holiday,
       trip_duration = difftime(trip_data_holiday$tpep_dropoff_datetime, trip_data_holiday$tpep_pickup_datetime, units='mins')
       )

# Create a column that speficies whether the trip is occuring on the weekend or on a weekday.
trip_data_day = mutate(trip_data_duration,
       is_weekend = case_when(
         as.POSIXlt(trip_data_duration$tpep_pickup_datetime)$wday == 0 ~ 1,
         as.POSIXlt(trip_data_duration$tpep_pickup_datetime)$wday == 6 ~ 1,
         as.POSIXlt(trip_data_duration$tpep_pickup_datetime)$wday > 0 & as.POSIXlt(trip_data_duration$tpep_pickup_datetime)$wday < 6 ~ 0
       )
       )
```


```{r}
# Remove non-sensical datapoints. (i.e. trips that last less than a minute, trips where the distance travelled is 0, trips listed as costing zero dollars,
# and trips in which the dropoff location was unspecified or outside of New York City).

trip_data_newer <- trip_data_day[trip_data_day$trip_duration > 1 & trip_data_day$total_amount >= 0 & trip_data_day$trip_distance >= 0 &
                       trip_data_day$DOLocationID < 264 & trip_data_day$passenger_count >= 1, ]
```



```{r}

# Load the CSV file that contains the taxi zone code information. Create a lists that relate each zone to its borough.
locations <- read.csv('taxi_zone_lookup.csv')

manhattan = c()
queens = c()
bronx = c()
staten_island = c()
brooklyn = c()
ewr = c()

for (i in 1: length(locations$LocationID)) {
  if (locations$Borough[i] == 'Manhattan') {
    manhattan <- append(manhattan, locations$LocationID[i])
  } else if (locations$Borough[i] == 'Queens') {
    queens <- append(queens, locations$LocationID[i])
  } else if (locations$Borough[i] == 'Bronx') {
    bronx <- append(bronx, locations$LocationID[i])
  } else if (locations$Borough[i] == 'Staten Island') {
    staten_island <- append(staten_island, locations$LocationID[i])
  } else if (locations$Borough[i] == 'Brooklyn') {
    brooklyn <- append(brooklyn, locations$LocationID[i])
  } else if (locations$Borough[i] == 'EWR') {
    ewr <- append(ewr, locations$LocationID[i])
  }
}

# Create a new column in trip_data that gives the borough of each trip's drop off location.
trip_data_loc = mutate(trip_data_newer,
                   dropoff_borough = case_when(
                     trip_data_newer$DOLocationID %in% manhattan ~ "Manhattan",
                     trip_data_newer$DOLocationID %in% queens ~ "Queens",
                     trip_data_newer$DOLocationID %in% bronx ~ "Bronx",
                     trip_data_newer$DOLocationID %in% brooklyn ~ "Brooklyn",
                     trip_data_newer$DOLocationID %in% staten_island ~ "Staten Island",
                     trip_data_newer$DOLocationID %in% ewr ~ "EWR",
                   )
                   )

```


```{r}
# Delete the columns that are no longer needed.
trip_data_final <- subset(trip_data_loc, select = -c(tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime, PULocationID, DOLocationID))

# Random sample the data so it works on laptop
set.seed(1)
trip_data_smol <- trip_data_final %>% sample_frac(0.05)

# Write the new, cleaned data into a CSV file.
write.csv(trip_data, "nyc_taxi_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```





PART 2


```{r}

trip_data_final$RatecodeID = factor(trip_data_final$RatecodeID)
trip_data_final$passenger_count = factor(trip_data_final$passenger_count)
trip_data_final$is_weekend = factor(trip_data_final$is_weekend)
trip_data_final$dropoff_borough = factor(trip_data_final$dropoff_borough)
trip_data_final$time_of_day = factor(trip_data_final$time_of_day)

model <- lm(tip_amount ~ passenger_count + trip_distance + trip_duration + RatecodeID + total_amount + time_of_day + is_holiday + is_weekend + dropoff_borough, data=trip_data_final)

x_values <- fitted(model)
y_values <- model$tip_amount

plot(x = x_values, y = y_values)

y_residuals <- resid(model)

plot(x = x_values, y = y_residuals)

```
